picks.title: Indian tech tycoon bets $30M of his own money to build AI alternative to Microsoft Office
picks.why_it_matters: Serial founder Bhavin Turakhia self-funding $30M signals strong conviction in AI-native productivity software as a category ripe for disruption—worth watching for co-investment opportunities or as a competitive benchmark for portfolio companies.

picks.title: Anthropic's Fable 5 is back after the Trump administration lifted export controls
picks.why_it_matters: Regulatory clarity on AI model exports directly impacts how AI-native startups can scale internationally and which foundation models they can build on.

picks.title: Weave Robotics launches Isaac 1, a $7,999 home robot with Fall 2026 deliveries
picks.why_it_matters: A sub-$8K consumer robot hitting market signals the home robotics category may finally be reaching viable price points, opening opportunities for adjacent software, components, and services startups.
